'''Kurdish rugs''' ({{langx|ku|فەرشی کوردی}}) are rugs woven by [[Kurds]] in [[Kurdistan]].<ref name="Neff">Neff, Ivan C. and Carol V. Maggs. Dictionary of Oriental Rugs. London: AD. Donker LTD, 1977. {{ISBN|978-0-949937-35-3}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Kurdish Rug Motif Designs and Their Meanings |url=https://www.kurdishrugs.com/learn/kurdish-rug-motif-designs-and-their-meanings |access-date=2022-03-28 |website=Kurdish Rugs |language=en-US}}</ref> When referring to Kurdish rugs within the rug industry, one is referring to those made within [[Iranian Kurdistan]].<ref name="Neff" />
